lessons: The last attempt stopped after about 20s of inspection and changed nothing. Begin editing early, in this order: chupa/help.py, then chupa/observe.py::snapshot, then chupa/stats.py::stats_tree, then the tests in the fence.

The chupa/help.py builders take read: Callable[[Path], str] and repo_url: str, and read only docs under Path(chupa.__file__).parent / 'docs'. A verb's what is its 'What it does' cell in host-running.md with backticks removed. A heading or verb row that does not resolve must raise.

Add one module-level function in chupa/observe.py. It is the only caller that passes Path.read_text and the importlib.metadata Repository URL to the builders. Monkeypatch it in tests/unit/test_menu_admission.py (both read_text fixtures) and tests/unit/test_verdict_menu_parity.py (world fixture).

Replace the hand-written engineVerbs detail with the verb topic's what. In tests/integration/test_watch.py, set the expected engineVerbs[0] detail to the drain row cell and add the help assertions from criterion 8. Do not touch vscode-chupa/, host-running.md, __main__.py or project_stats.
Commit your work as you go and run every ## Verification command, finishing with ./dev.py test. Report incomplete only with a committed partial diff and the blocker named.
